name: Beaks 🦆
desc:
Welcome to Beaks – a mysterious world full of birds, secrets, and adventure!

Grab your dart rifle, load up your gear, and get ready to capture all kinds of birds – from parrots, falcons to flamingos! 

Like & Follow the game for secret rewards!
Music by @matiasmedinamusic

    end
end
